manifest.name: ima2.get_image_context
manifest.description: Load the session image context manifest (previous images, current image, locks). Runs automatically before image generation.

manifest.name: ima2.web_search
manifest.description: Search the web for factual visual references before generating. Only available when web search is enabled for the session.

query.description: Search query for factual visual accuracy.

manifest.name: ima2.generate_image
manifest.description: Generate one or more images. Supports fanout: provide one prompt per variant.

prompts.description: One generation prompt per planned variant (1 to the configured image limit).

sourceImagePolicy.description: none creates a fresh image and ignores the current session image; current uses the current session image as edit/reference input; auto lets the runtime choose.

manifest.name: ima2.get_generation_errors
manifest.description: Read-only lookup of the session's recent generation failures (failed queue jobs and error turns). Use when the user asks why a generation failed.

limit.description: Maximum error records to return. Default 10.
